features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance label production

items.title: All-in-One Hybrid Printing Architecture
items.desc: Combines digital inkjet, flexo, and cold foil printing in a single integrated machine, eliminating the need for separate printing and finishing equipment and reducing production floor space and handling steps.

items.title: Plug-in Modular Design
items.desc: Future-ready modular system allows operators to add or reconfigure printing and finishing modules as production requirements evolve, protecting the initial investment with scalable upgrade capability.

items.title: Epson S3200 Industrial Printhead
items.desc: High-performance Epson S3200 printhead delivers sharp, precise label printing at up to 1200 x 600 dpi with consistent nozzle performance across long production runs on all supported substrates.

items.title: 7-Color System for 90 Percent Colour Gamut
items.desc: Up to 7-color ink configuration extends the printable colour gamut beyond standard CMYK, achieving 90 percent or higher colour accuracy for brands requiring precise colour matching on shelf-facing labels.

items.title: Pre-Flexo with Cold Foil Unit
items.desc: Integrated pre-flexo station with cold foil application adds metallic and holographic foil effects inline without stopping production, enabling premium label finishes in a single continuous pass.

items.title: Automated Camera Inspection System
items.desc: Inline automated inspection camera continuously monitors print quality during production, detecting defects, misregistration, and colour inconsistencies in real time before they reach the finished roll.

items.title: G7 Certified UV Ink System
items.desc: G7 certified UV inks ensure consistent, standardised colour output across production runs and across machines, giving label printers the colour accuracy confidence required for brand-sensitive packaging clients.

items.title: Self-Developed MES System with Remote Service
items.desc: Integrated manufacturing execution system combined with remote service and maintenance capability gives operators full production visibility while enabling fast, efficient technical support without on-site engineer visits.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of label and packaging applications, delivering exceptional print quality, colour accuracy, and production efficiency.

fabrics.title: Pharma and Agro Labels
fabrics.desc: High-resolution variable data printing and G7 colour accuracy make the JetRix-E well suited to pharmaceutical, agrochemical, and crop protection label production requiring regulatory compliance and precise colour consistency.

fabrics.title: Food and Beverage Labels
fabrics.desc: Vibrant 7-color output, cold foil capability, and multi-substrate support suit premium food and beverage label production for brands competing on shelf visibility and packaging quality.

fabrics.title: Wine and Water Labels
fabrics.desc: Cold foil, spot colour, and Pantone matching deliver the premium finish quality demanded by wine, spirits, and mineral water brands for high-end retail label applications.

fabrics.title: Cosmetics and Daily Chemicals
fabrics.desc: High-quality digital printing with optional foil effects and spot colour channels suits cosmetics, personal care, and household chemical label producers requiring premium brand presentation.

fabrics.title: Shrink Labels and Laminated Tubes
fabrics.desc: Multi-substrate compatibility including PET, PVC, and PP films makes the JetRix-E a capable solution for shrink sleeve, laminated tube, and flexible packaging label applications.

fabrics.title: Variable Data and Serialisation Printing
fabrics.desc: Pure digital inkjet architecture enables seamless variable data printing for serialisation, batch coding, unique identifiers, and personalised label production without plate changes or downtime.

fabrics.title: Lubricant and Industrial Labels
fabrics.desc: Durable UV ink on film substrates and aluminium foil produces robust, chemical-resistant labels for lubricants, automotive products, and industrial goods requiring long-lasting print quality.

fabrics.title: Short-Run and Brand-Extension Label Production
fabrics.desc: No plate cylinder cost, fast job switching, and modular configuration make the JetRix-E the most cost-efficient choice for converters managing short runs, brand extensions, and frequent design changeovers.

productionCapacity.description: Choose the ideal speed and resolution combination to optimize production output and print performance.

globalComponents.description: Built using premium international components that deliver superior accuracy, durability, and consistent production efficiency.

smallCards.title: Automated Camera Inspection System

smallCards.title: Self-Developed MES System

smallCards.title: Remote Service and Maintenance Platform
smallCards.desc: Remote diagnostic and technical support capability reducing engineer visit requirements and minimising production downtime

smallCards.title: G7 Certified UV Ink System
smallCards.desc: Standardised colour-accurate UV inks meeting G7 colour management certification for consistent, repeatable brand output

smallCards.title: ONYX RIP Software
smallCards.desc: Advanced RIP software with Pantone matching, ICC colour management, variable data support, and complete label production workflow tools

smallCards.title: High-Speed PCIE Data Transmission
smallCards.desc: Industrial-grade high-speed data transmission ensuring uninterrupted data flow to the printhead at all production speeds
